description: Crispy fried cassava chips, a popular Kenyan snack served with kachumbari or chilli sauce.

steps.instruction: Peel cassava, remove the woody core, and cut into thin strips or wedges. Rinse well.
Heat oil in a deep pan. Fry cassava in batches for 5–7 minutes until golden and crisp.
Drain on paper towels, sprinkle with salt, and serve hot with kachumbari.

serving_suggestion: Serve as a snack with kachumbari or chilli sauce.

description: Cassava chunks simmered in a rich tomato and onion stew, a filling Kenyan vegetarian main.

steps.instruction: Peel and cube cassava. Sauté onion and garlic in oil until golden.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook until they form a sauce.
Add cassava, salt and water. Cover and simmer for 20–25 minutes until cassava is tender. Serve hot.

description: A smooth, comforting porridge made from grated cassava and millet flour, sweetened lightly.

steps.instruction: Peel and grate cassava. Mix millet flour with a little water to form a paste.
Bring remaining water to a boil, add grated cassava and cook for 10 minutes.
Stir in millet paste and salt. Cook for 8–10 minutes until thick. Sweeten if desired and serve warm.

description: Cassava and beans simmered together in a tomato-onion sauce, a hearty Kenyan one-pot meal.

steps.instruction: Peel and cube cassava. Sauté onion until golden, add tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add cassava, beans, salt and water.
Simmer for 20–25 minutes until cassava is tender. Serve hot.

description: Tender cassava simmered in creamy coconut milk with onions and a hint of chilli.

steps.instruction: Peel and cube cassava. Sauté onion in oil until soft.
Add cassava, coconut milk, chilli and salt.
Simmer for 20 minutes until cassava is tender and sauce thickens. Serve with rice.

description: Cowpea leaves simmered in creamy coconut milk with onions and mild spices, a coastal Kenyan side.

steps.instruction: Wash and chop cowpea leaves. Sauté onion in oil until soft.
Add cowpea leaves and cook for 3 minutes.
Pour in coconut milk and salt. Simmer for 10 minutes until tender. Serve hot.

description: Cowpea leaves cooked with groundnut paste, tomatoes and onions, a rich Kenyan stew.

steps.instruction: Grind groundnuts into a paste. Sauté onion until golden, add tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add groundnut paste and water, stir to combine.
Add cowpea leaves and salt, simmer for 10–15 minutes. Serve with ugali.

description: Cowpea leaves sautéed with onions and scrambled eggs, a nutritious Kenyan breakfast.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion in oil until soft. Add chopped cowpea leaves and cook for 3 minutes.
Beat eggs with salt and pour over the greens.
Scramble until eggs are set. Serve with chapati or bread.

description: Cowpea leaves cooked with onions and tomatoes, served alongside hot ugali.

steps.instruction: Boil water and salt, gradually add maize flour and stir until firm. Shape ugali.
Sauté onion in oil until golden. Add tomatoes and cook until saucy. Add cowpea leaves and cook for 5–7 minutes.
Serve the cowpea leaves with the hot ugali.

description: Cowpea leaves and beans simmered together in a tomato-onion sauce, a protein-rich Kenyan stew.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion until golden, add tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add beans and cook for 5 minutes. Add cowpea leaves and salt.
Cook for 5–7 minutes until leaves are tender. Serve with ugali.

name_sw: Saladi ya Tango na Maziwa ya Mgando
description: A refreshing Kenyan salad of cucumber, yogurt, mint and a hint of garlic.

steps.instruction: Peel and grate cucumber, then squeeze out excess water.
Mix yogurt, crushed garlic, chopped mint and salt.
Stir in cucumber and serve chilled.

serving_suggestion: Serve as a side with pilau or grilled meat.

description: A simple Kenyan salad of cucumber, tomatoes, red onion and lemon juice.

steps.instruction: Slice cucumber and tomatoes. Finely chop red onion.
Combine in a bowl and squeeze lemon juice over.
Add salt, toss gently and serve fresh.

serving_suggestion: Serve with nyama choma or rice.

description: A creamy Kenyan salad combining cucumber, avocado, red onion and lime.

steps.instruction: Dice cucumber and avocado. Finely chop red onion.
Combine and squeeze lime juice over.
Add salt, toss gently and serve immediately.

serving_suggestion: Serve as a side or light meal.

description: A cooling Kenyan juice made from cucumber, lemon and a touch of honey or sugar.

steps.instruction: Peel and chop cucumber. Blend with water until smooth.
Strain through a sieve. Add lemon juice and sugar.
Stir well, chill and serve over ice.

serving_suggestion: Serve chilled as a refreshing drink.

description: A Kenyan kachumbari with cucumber, tomatoes, red onion and coriander.

steps.instruction: Dice cucumber and tomatoes. Finely chop red onion and coriander.
Combine in a bowl and squeeze lime juice over.
Add salt, toss gently and serve fresh.

serving_suggestion: Serve with nyama choma or pilau.

description: Eggplant cubes simmered in a spiced tomato and onion curry sauce.

steps.instruction: Cut eggplant into cubes and salt lightly. Sauté onion and garlic until soft.
Add curry powder and tomatoes, cook until saucy. Add eggplant.
Simmer for 15–20 minutes until eggplant is tender. Serve with rice.

description: Eggplant slices brushed with oil and grilled until charred, served with a lemon dressing.

steps.instruction: Slice eggplant into thick rounds. Brush with oil and season with salt.
Grill on a hot pan or barbecue for 4–5 minutes per side until charred.
Mix lemon juice and crushed garlic, drizzle over eggplant and serve.

serving_suggestion: Serve as a side with grilled meat.

description: Eggplant simmered with tomatoes, onions and garlic in a rich Kenyan stew.

steps.instruction: Cube eggplant. Sauté onion and garlic until soft. Add tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add eggplant and salt.
Simmer for 15 minutes until eggplant is tender. Serve with ugali.

description: Eggplant and beans cooked together in a tomato-onion sauce, a filling Kenyan vegetarian stew.

steps.instruction: Cube eggplant. Sauté onion until golden, add tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add eggplant and beans, season with salt.
Simmer for 15–20 minutes until eggplant is tender. Serve hot.

description: Roasted eggplant mixed with tomatoes, onions and lemon, a smoky Kenyan salad.

steps.instruction: Roast whole eggplant over flame or in oven until skin chars and flesh softens. Cool, peel and chop.
Dice tomatoes and red onion. Mix with eggplant.
Add lemon juice, oil and salt. Toss and serve.

serving_suggestion: Serve as a side with grilled fish or meat.

description: Mushrooms simmered in a rich tomato and onion gravy, a hearty Kenyan vegetarian stew.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion and garlic in oil until soft. Add chopped tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add sliced mushrooms and cook for 5 minutes.
Add salt and water, simmer for 10 minutes. Serve with rice or ugali.

description: Mushrooms cooked in a spiced curry sauce with onions, tomatoes and curry powder.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion until golden. Add curry powder and tomatoes, cook until saucy.
Add mushrooms and salt, stir to coat.
Cook for 10–12 minutes until mushrooms are tender. Serve with rice.

description: Mushrooms sautéed with spinach, onions and garlic, a nutritious Kenyan side dish.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion and garlic until soft. Add sliced mushrooms and cook for 4 minutes.
Add spinach and salt.
Stir until spinach wilts, about 5 minutes. Serve hot.

description: Fragrant Kenyan pilau rice cooked with mushrooms, pilau masala and caramelised onions.

steps.instruction: Fry onions until deep golden. Add mushrooms and cook until browned.
Stir in pilau masala and rice. Add water and salt.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes until rice is tender. Fluff and serve.

description: A creamy Kenyan soup made with mushrooms, onions, garlic and milk.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion and garlic until soft. Add sliced mushrooms and cook for 5 minutes.
Add water and simmer for 10 minutes. Blend until smooth.
Stir in milk and salt, heat through and serve.

serving_suggestion: Serve with bread or as a starter.

description: Okra simmered in a tomato and onion stew, a simple Kenyan vegetarian dish.

steps.instruction: Cut okra into pieces. Sauté onion until golden, add tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add okra and salt.
Add water and simmer for 10–12 minutes until okra is tender. Serve with ugali.

description: Okra cooked with ripe tomatoes, onions and a hint of chilli, a tangy Kenyan side.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion in oil until soft. Add tomatoes and chilli, cook until saucy.
Add sliced okra and salt.
Cook for 8–10 minutes until okra is tender. Serve hot.

description: Okra and beans simmered together in a tomato-onion sauce, a nutritious Kenyan stew.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion until golden, add tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add beans and okra, season with salt.
Simmer for 10–12 minutes until okra is tender. Serve with ugali.

description: Okra simmered in a creamy coconut curry with onions, tomatoes and mild spices.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion until soft. Add curry powder and tomatoes, cook until saucy.
Add okra and coconut milk.
Simmer for 12–15 minutes until okra is tender. Season and serve with rice.

description: Okra cooked with onions and tomatoes, served alongside hot ugali.

steps.instruction: Boil water and salt, gradually add maize flour and stir until firm. Shape ugali.
Sauté onion until golden, add tomatoes and cook until saucy. Add okra and cook for 8 minutes.
Serve okra with hot ugali.

description: Pumpkin cubes simmered in a savoury tomato and onion stew, a comforting Kenyan dish.

steps.instruction: Peel and cube pumpkin. Sauté onion and garlic until soft.
Add tomatoes and cook until saucy. Add pumpkin, salt and water.
Cover and simmer for 15–20 minutes until pumpkin is tender. Serve with rice.

description: Pumpkin and beans cooked together in a tomato-onion sauce, a hearty Kenyan vegetarian stew.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion until golden, add tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add cubed pumpkin and beans, season with salt.
Simmer for 15–20 minutes until pumpkin is tender. Serve hot.

description: Pumpkin cooked in a spiced coconut curry with onions, tomatoes and curry powder.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion until soft. Add curry powder and tomatoes, cook until saucy.
Add pumpkin and coconut milk.
Simmer for 15–20 minutes until pumpkin is tender. Season and serve with rice.

description: A smooth, sweet Kenyan porridge made with pumpkin and millet flour.

steps.instruction: Peel and cube pumpkin. Boil in water for 10 minutes until soft.
Mash pumpkin. Mix millet flour with a little water and stir into the pot.
Cook for 8–10 minutes until thick. Add sugar if desired and serve warm.

description: Pumpkin simmered in a rich groundnut sauce with onions and tomatoes.

steps.instruction: Grind groundnuts into a paste. Sauté onion until golden, add tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add groundnut paste and water, stir. Add cubed pumpkin and salt.
Simmer for 15–20 minutes until pumpkin is tender. Serve with rice.

description: A fresh Kenyan salad of spring onions, tomatoes, lemon and a pinch of salt.

steps.instruction: Chop spring onions and tomatoes.
Combine in a bowl and squeeze lemon juice over.
Add salt, toss gently and serve fresh.

serving_suggestion: Serve with grilled meat or rice.

description: Fragrant rice cooked with spring onions, butter and a pinch of salt.

steps.instruction: Chop spring onions. Heat butter (or oil) and sauté spring onions until soft.
Add rice, water and salt. Bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Fluff and serve.

description: Chicken pieces stir-fried with spring onions, garlic and a savoury sauce.

steps.instruction: Brown chicken in oil for 6–8 minutes. Add garlic and chopped spring onions, cook for 3 minutes.
Add water and salt.
Simmer for 15 minutes until chicken is cooked and sauce reduces. Serve with rice.

description: A light Kenyan soup made with spring onions, potatoes and milk.

steps.instruction: Chop spring onions and potatoes. Sauté spring onions in oil until soft.
Add potatoes and water, simmer for 15 minutes until potatoes are tender. Blend until smooth.
Stir in milk and salt, heat through and serve.

description: Beans simmered with spring onions, tomatoes and garlic, a flavourful Kenyan stew.

steps.instruction: Chop spring onions and garlic. Sauté in oil until soft.
Add tomatoes and cook until saucy. Add beans and salt.
Simmer for 10 minutes. Serve with rice or chapati.

description: Fragrant rice cooked with butter and onions, a rich Kenyan side dish.

steps.instruction: Melt butter in a pot. Sauté onion until soft.
Add rice and stir to coat with butter. Add water and salt.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes until rice is tender. Fluff and serve.

description: Chicken pieces simmered in a rich, buttery tomato sauce with a touch of cream or milk.

steps.instruction: Brown chicken in half the butter. Remove. Sauté onion and garlic in remaining butter until soft.
Add tomatoes and cook until they break down into a thick sauce.
Return chicken, add salt and milk (if using). Simmer for 15 minutes. Serve with rice.

description: Beans simmered in a buttery tomato and onion sauce, a rich Kenyan vegetarian stew.

steps.instruction: Melt butter and sauté onion until golden. Add tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add beans and salt.
Simmer for 10–15 minutes. Serve with rice or chapati.

description: Soft layered Kenyan chapati brushed with butter, giving a rich, flaky texture.

steps.instruction: Mix flour and salt. Add water and knead into a soft dough. Rest for 30 minutes.
Divide into balls, roll thin, brush with melted butter, fold into a spiral and roll again.
Cook on a hot pan for 2–3 minutes per side, brushing with butter, until golden.

description: Mixed vegetables sautéed in butter with onions and a pinch of black pepper.

steps.instruction: Slice carrots and green beans. Melt butter and sauté onion until soft.
Add carrots and green beans, cook for 8–10 minutes until tender.
Season with salt and black pepper. Serve hot.

serving_suggestion: Serve with grilled meat or rice.

description: A comforting Kenyan tea made with fresh milk, tea leaves and sugar.

steps.instruction: Bring fresh milk and water to a gentle boil.
Add tea leaves and sugar, simmer for 5 minutes.
Strain into cups and serve hot.

description: A creamy Kenyan porridge made with millet flour and fresh milk, sweetened lightly.

steps.instruction: Mix millet flour with a little water to form a paste.
Bring remaining water to a boil, stir in paste and cook for 8 minutes.
Add fresh milk and sugar, simmer for 3 minutes and serve warm.

name_sw: Pudding ya Wali na Maziwa Mapya
description: A creamy Kenyan rice pudding made with fresh milk, sugar and cardamom.

steps.instruction: Rinse rice. Combine rice and fresh milk in a pot.
Bring to a boil, then simmer on low heat for 25 minutes, stirring often, until rice is soft and creamy.
Stir in sugar and cardamom. Serve warm or chilled.

serving_suggestion: Serve as a dessert or snack.

description: A creamy Kenyan smoothie made with fresh milk, banana and a touch of sugar.

steps.instruction: Peel and chop bananas.
Blend fresh milk, bananas and sugar until smooth.
Pour into glasses and serve chilled.

description: A softer, richer ugali made with fresh milk instead of water, served with greens or stew.

steps.instruction: Bring fresh milk and salt to a boil in a heavy pot.
Gradually add maize flour while stirring continuously to prevent lumps.
Reduce heat and keep stirring for 8–10 minutes until firm. Shape and serve.

serving_suggestion: Serve with sukuma wiki or beef stew.
